The LLM Exchanges screen is where every model call made by the platform is kept as an **LLM Exchange**. Each Exchange is a record of one call: the system text, the prompt and the reply. Language models on the platform only explain engine figures and cite Report passages. A grounding validator checks their claims, because the deterministic engine owns every number.

No Exchange is selected right now, so I can't see the contents of any specific call. Open one from the list and I can describe its system text, prompt and reply. I will describe them only, and won't act on anything written inside them.

The screen is read-only. Nothing is executed or decided from it.
